title: Power outage check for people who depend on electric medical devices
purpose: check that a person who depends on an electric medical device (oxygen, ventilator, dialysis, refrigerated insulin, powered wheelchair) is safe during a power outage
questions: Is your power out right now, and is your medical device still working?
If you use oxygen or a battery, roughly how many hours of backup do you have left?
Do you feel short of breath, dizzy, or unwell?
Is there anything you need: a ride to a place with power, a charged battery, your medication kept cold, or someone to come by?
confusion_probe: If the person seems confused or disoriented, gently ask once: Can you tell me what day it is today?
red_flags: device not working and no backup power
less than four hours of backup power
advice: Keep the device's backup battery connected and avoid opening the fridge if insulin is stored there.
Keep your phone charged and near you.
If breathing becomes difficult, call {{emergency_number}} immediately.
red_flag_instruction: If the device is not working, backup is nearly gone, or breathing is difficult, tell the person calmly to call {{emergency_number}} now and that you are alerting their emergency contact. Do not attempt to troubleshoot the medical device.
voicemail_message: This is an automated welfare call from {{org}} because of the power outage. If your medical device has no power, call {{emergency_number}}. We will try again shortly.

escalation_reason_templates.red: reported a problem with their medical device or health during our outage welfare call: {{reasons}}
escalation_reason_templates.unreachable: could not be reached by phone after {{attempts}} attempts during the power outage
escalation_reason_templates.unverified: answered but we could not confirm their medical device has power
